mapper.sql: s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND s.deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.deleted=0) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0 AND r.role_code IN ('MERCHANT_ADMIN','FINANCE_OPERATOR','WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR','CUSTOMER_SERVICE_OPERATOR')) OR ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.role_code='MERCHANT_OPERATOR' AND r.role_scope='TENANT' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.deleted=0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_store_scope uss WHERE uss.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND uss.user_id=#{userId} AND uss.store_id=s.id AND uss.status='ACTIVE') ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(current_status='DRAFT'),0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='PENDING_INBOUND'),0) AS pendingInbound, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='INBOUND'),0) AS inbound, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION'),0) AS pendingPriceConfirmation, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND'),0) AS readyForOutbound, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='OUTBOUND'),0) AS outbound, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='IN_TRANSIT'),0) AS inTransit, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='DELIVERED'),0) AS delivered, COALESCE(SUM(current_status IN ('EXCEPTION','LOST','RETURNED')),0) AS exception, COALESCE(SUM(current_status='CANCELLED'),0) AS cancelled FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND current_status='PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION') AS pendingPriceConfirmation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reconciliation_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND reconciliation_status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION') AS pendingReconciliation, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN ('OPEN','PROCESSING')) AS activeExceptions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claim_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status='SUBMITTED') AS submittedClaims
SELECT s.id FROM merchant_store s WHERE AND s.id=#{storeId} ORDER BY s.id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND','OUTBOUND','IN_TRANSIT') AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='PENDING_INBOUND' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_inbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='INBOUND' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_package sp JOIN warehouse_measurement wm ON wm.shipment_package_id=sp.id WHERE sp.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND sp.shipment_order_id=o.id AND wm.tenant_id=o.tenant_id) AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_measurement, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE AND o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND COALESCE(po.lifecycle_status,'') <> 'LABEL_READY' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_label, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE AND o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND po.lifecycle_status='LABEL_READY' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_outbound, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='IN_TRANSIT' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS in_transit, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.shipment_order_id) FROM tracking_event t JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=t.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE AND t.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED') AND t.received_time >= #{from} AND t.received_time < #{to}) AS tracking_exception, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_adjustment fa JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=fa.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=fa.tenant_id WHERE AND fa.confirmation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REQUESTED') AND fa.created_at >= #{from} AND fa.created_at < #{to}) AS pending_fee_confirmation, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) FROM bill_import_batch b JOIN bill_detail d ON d.bill_import_batch_id=b.id AND d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=d.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE AND (b.status IN ('FAILED','PARTIAL_SUCCESS') OR d.detail_status='ERROR') AND b.created_at >= #{from} AND b.created_at < #{to}) AS bill_import_errors, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reconciliation_record rr JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=rr.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id WHERE AND rr.reconciliation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REJECTED') AND rr.difference_amount <> 0 AND rr.created_at >= #{from} AND rr.created_at < #{to}) AS reconciliation_difference, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_case e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE AND e.status='PENDING_FINANCE_CONFIRMATION' AND e.created_at >= #{from} AND e.created_at < #{to}) AS pending_finance_review, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.shipment_order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='RECEIVER') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_address a WHERE a.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND a.shipment_order_id=o.id AND a.address_type='SENDER')) AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS missing_address, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customs_document cd WHERE cd.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND cd.shipment_order_id=o.id AND cd.document_status='UPLOADED') AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS missing_customs_document, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND') AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}) AS pending_warehouse, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_case e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE AND e.status IN ('OPEN','PROCESSING','WAITING_PROVIDER_FEEDBACK') AND e.created_at >= #{from} AND e.created_at < #{to}) AS pending_exception_follow_up, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reconciliation_record rr JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=rr.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id WHERE AND rr.reconciliation_status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND rr.created_at >= #{from} AND rr.created_at < #{to}) AS pending_reconciliation

SELECT id, type, level, title, resource_type, resource_id, store_id, occurred_at, description FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('QUOTE:',q.id) AS id, 'QUOTE_EXPIRING' AS type, 'MEDIUM' AS level, '报价即将过期' AS title, 'QUOTE' AS resource_type, q.id AS resource_id, q.store_id, q.valid_to AS occurred_at, '报价将在平台默认24小时阈值内过期' AS description FROM quote q JOIN merchant_store s ON s.id=q.store_id AND s.tenant_id=q.tenant_id WHERE AND q.status='VALID' AND q.valid_to >= #{asOf} AND q.valid_to <= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, #{thresholdHours}, #{asOf}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) AS id, 'ORDER_UNPROCESSED' AS type, 'MEDIUM' AS level, '订单长时间未处理' AS title, 'SHIPMENT_ORDER' AS resource_type, o.id AS resource_id, o.store_id, o.created_at AS occurred_at, '订单创建超过平台默认24小时阈值且仍未完成处理' AS description FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION') AND o.created_at < TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{thresholdHours}, #{asOf}) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('SF:',o.id) AS id, 'SF_CALL_FAILED' AS type, 'HIGH' AS level, '顺丰调用失败' AS title, 'SHIPMENT_ORDER' AS resource_type, o.id AS resource_id, o.store_id, po.updated_at AS occurred_at, COALESCE(po.last_error_summary,'物流服务调用失败，请检查重试状态') AS description FROM provider_order po JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=po.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=po.tenant_id WHERE AND po.lifecycle_status='FAILED' AND po.updated_at >= #{from} AND po.updated_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('TRACKING:',t.id) AS id, 'TRACKING_EXCEPTION' AS type, 'HIGH' AS level, '轨迹异常' AS title, 'TRACKING_EVENT' AS resource_type, t.shipment_order_id AS resource_id, o.store_id, t.event_time AS occurred_at, COALESCE(t.process_message,t.event_description,'轨迹事件处理异常') AS description FROM tracking_event t JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=t.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE AND t.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED') AND t.received_time >= #{from} AND t.received_time < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('RECON:',rr.id) AS id, 'RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE' AS type, 'MEDIUM' AS level, '费用差异' AS title, 'RECONCILIATION' AS resource_type, rr.id AS resource_id, o.store_id, rr.created_at AS occurred_at, CONCAT('对账差异金额：', rr.difference_amount, ' ', d.currency) AS description FROM reconciliation_record rr JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=rr.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id JOIN bill_detail d ON d.id=rr.bill_detail_id AND d.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id WHERE AND rr.reconciliation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REJECTED') AND rr.difference_amount <> 0 AND rr.created_at >= #{from} AND rr.created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CUSTOMS:',o.id) AS id, 'CUSTOMS_DOCUMENT_MISSING' AS type, 'MEDIUM' AS level, '清关资料缺失' AS title, 'SHIPMENT_ORDER' AS resource_type, o.id AS resource_id, o.store_id, o.updated_at AS occurred_at, '订单尚未存在已上传的清关资料' AS description FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND') AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customs_document cd WHERE cd.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND cd.shipment_order_id=o.id AND cd.document_status='UPLOADED') ) risk ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.when: SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_INBOUND','INBOUND','PENDING_PRICE_CONFIRMATION','READY_FOR_OUTBOUND','OUTBOUND','IN_TRANSIT') AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='PENDING_INBOUND' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order + warehouse_measurement' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='INBOUND' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipment_package sp JOIN warehouse_measurement wm ON wm.shipment_package_id=sp.id WHERE sp.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND sp.shipment_order_id=o.id AND wm.tenant_id=o.tenant_id) AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order + provider_order' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o LEFT JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE AND o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND COALESCE(po.lifecycle_status,'') <> 'LABEL_READY' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order + provider_order' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o JOIN provider_order po ON po.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND po.shipment_order_id=o.id WHERE AND o.current_status='READY_FOR_OUTBOUND' AND po.lifecycle_status='LABEL_READY' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'shipment_order' source,o.updated_at occurred_at FROM shipment_order o WHERE AND o.current_status='IN_TRANSIT' AND o.updated_at >= #{from} AND o.updated_at < #{to}

SELECT CONCAT('ORDER:',o.id) item_id,'SHIPMENT_ORDER' resource_type,o.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,o.current_status status,'tracking_event' source,MAX(t.received_time) occurred_at FROM tracking_event t JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=t.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE AND t.process_status IN ('RETRY','REJECTED') AND t.received_time >= #{from} AND t.received_time < #{to} GROUP BY o.id,o.store_id,o.order_no,o.current_status

SELECT CONCAT('FEE:',fa.id) item_id,'FEE_ADJUSTMENT' resource_type,fa.id resource_id,o.id order_id,o.store_id, o.order_no display_no,fa.confirmation_status status,'fee_adjustment' source,fa.created_at occurred_at FROM fee_adjustment fa JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=fa.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=fa.tenant_id WHERE AND fa.confirmation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REQUESTED') AND fa.created_at >= #{from} AND fa.created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('BATCH:',b.id),'BILL_IMPORT_BATCH',b.id,o.id,o.store_id,b.batch_no,b.status, 'bill_import_batch',b.created_at FROM bill_import_batch b JOIN bill_detail d ON d.bill_import_batch_id=b.id AND d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=d.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE AND (b.status IN ('FAILED','PARTIAL_SUCCESS') OR d.detail_status='ERROR') AND b.created_at >= #{from} AND b.created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('RECON:',rr.id),'RECONCILIATION',rr.id,o.id,o.store_id,o.order_no,rr.reconciliation_status, 'reconciliation_record',rr.created_at FROM reconciliation_record rr JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=rr.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id WHERE AND rr.reconciliation_status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION','REJECTED') AND rr.difference_amount <> 0 AND rr.created_at >= #{from} AND rr.created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('EXCEPTION:',e.id),'EXCEPTION_CASE',e.id,o.id,o.store_id,o.order_no,e.status, 'exception_case',e.created_at FROM exception_case e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE AND e.status='PENDING_FINANCE_CONFIRMATION' AND e.created_at >= #{from} AND e.created_at < #{to}
